verdict.justification: Both deliverables provide the three required file types, preserve the required business fields and tracker columns, and correctly apply the authorized USD 5,000 threshold rather than the later unapproved USD 50,000 proposal. B is the stronger operational package: its tracker adds “Review Pathway” and “Signed Form Archive Reference,” making routing and archive traceability more usable than A’s basic ten-column register. B’s form also separates formal and fast-track approval blocks and distinguishes QC input and Tech Ops assessment from accountable approvals more clearly. A introduces an unresolved routing contradiction by allowing shifts between one and two business days to use fast-track while limiting fast-track eligibility to timelines “beyond a 1-day adjustment.” B instead establishes a conservative fallback to formal review when a change is not fast-track eligible and explicitly keeps escalated requests open pending resolution. B still needs cleanup before routing, particularly removal of preprinted decision text such as “Submitted” and “Assessment provided” from the blank form, but its overall structure and process-to-template alignment are stronger.

decisive_issues.issue: The proposed handling of one-to-two-day timeline shifts conflicts with the stated fast-track eligibility limit.
decisive_issues.quote: A change qualifies for fast-track only if it does not impact timelines (beyond a 1-day adjustment), scope, budget or compliance

decisive_issues.issue: The tracker includes useful explicit links to routing and archived approval evidence.
decisive_issues.quote: The template also includes two supporting columns – Review Pathway and Signed Form Archive Reference – to link each entry to its approval route and archived record.

decisive_issues.issue: Escalation handling clearly preserves the open request until a decision is recorded.
decisive_issues.quote: CR remains open in the tracker; the PM refers it to the escalation authority

decisive_issues.issue: Preprinted assessment-completion text should be removed from factual decision cells in the blank form.
